sentences.text:
Apratim Banerjee & Ors vs Unknown on 2 March, 2026
02.03.2026
Item No.8
Ct. No. 34
 nb
 Crr 850 of 2026

In the matter of: Apratim Banerjee & Ors.
 ...... petitioners.

Mr. Anirban Dutta,
 Ms. Neha Gupta,
 Mr. Younus Sultan,
 ....For the Petitioners.

1. 
Heard the submission of the learned advocate.

2. The matter pertains to quashing of the proceeding pending before the Learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate at Barrackpore in connection with complaint lodged by the present opposite party no.2 under Sections 498A/406 of the IPC.
Investigation culminated by filing of charge sheet only 489A against the present petitioners while discharging the other family members, who were arrayed as accused in the said complaint.
Charge-sheet itself manifests the opposite party no.2 left the matrimonial home voluntarily.

Hence, an arguable case has been made out regarding any offence to be committed by the present petitioners especially the petitioner nos. 2 and 3.
3.

Therefore, the petitioner is directed to serve copy of the revisional application upon the State in the office of the Public Prosecutor, High Court Calcutta as also to the opposite parties through Speed Post and file affidavit of service on the returnable date.

4. The matter be appeared four weeks hence under the heading "Contested Application".
5.
In the mean time, let there be stay of all further proceeding pending before the Court of Magistrate till April 30, 2026 or until further order, whichever is earlier.
6. All parties shall act on the server copies of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
